scope: Frozen runtime declaration for the 1800-episode primary matrix. The authoritative runtime gate is benchmarks/protocol_v1/runtime_validation.json, which can only be produced by real native runs (scripts/record_runtime_validation.py). Nothing here substitutes for that evidence.

vehicle.classification: Common Isaac equivalent vehicle from the pinned Fast-Planner SO3 sources; PhysX replaces the upstream ODE integration. Not a claim of YOPO platform identity.

sensor.enforcement: scripts/record_runtime_validation.py validate_camera() rejects any flight whose camera block differs; the aggregation builder enforces the same block for on-policy data.

criteria.collision: Any physical contact or conservative vehicle-envelope signed distance<=0
criteria.goal: Within0.5m and speed<0.3m/s continuously0.5s, without collision
criteria.confidence_interval: Wilson95% with n30, and separate first10 paper-size subset
criteria.latency: Count wall acquisition/communication/planning delay in simulation-time command availability; report wall and simulation times and RTF
criteria.safety: Report both center-to-obstacle distance and net envelope clearance
criteria.smoothness: Report reference jerk integral and separately measured-state derivative metrics with any filtering disclosed

command_application.rule: a trajectory becomes available at capture_sim_time + measured wall acquisition/communication/planning delay

timing_reporting.clock: ROS simulation clock published by the native process

yopo_seed0.admission_requirement: training_audit.json passed with 50 epochs and the checkpoint hash equal to selection.best_policy_file_sha256

network_input.depth: 160x90 raw metres resized to 160x96 with cv2.INTER_LINEAR
network_input.observation: 9 values: body velocity, body acceleration, body-frame goal direction

notes: official YOPO weights are explicitly excluded from the primary matrix

declared_differences: The original mapping/ESDF pipeline is limited to the 4.5 m depth filter and max ray length (sdf_map.depth_filter_maxdist=4.5, sdf_map.max_ray_length=4.5) while the common sensor supplies 20 m depth. This is a genuine difference and must be reported with the method's results.

sdf_map.max_acc stays at the config value 6.0 m/s^2 while episode speeds reach 10 m/s; whether this is a fair configuration for the high-speed cells is an open fairness question and is recorded as pending, not silently adjusted.
sdf_map.resolution is 0.1 m and obstacles_inflation is 0.099 m; the TopoTraj result therefore has a different collision margin than the network methods.

agile_autonomy.weights: official Agile Autonomy ckpt-50 converted without training
agile_autonomy.admission_requirement: artifacts/agile_autonomy/torch_export_v1/torch_cuda_parity.json must be passed for the requested device
notes: the official Agile weights are an external baseline only and are never used as YOPO evidence

mppi_reference17.prohibition: No other MPPI project may be substituted; the 300 slots stay explicitly unexecuted until a paper-based re-implementation is commissioned or the authors' code is obtained.

expert_50_steps.note: Table I comparison on the independent offline test set; it is not a closed-loop episode model and therefore has no slots in the 1800 matrix.

runtime_files.note: scripts/record_runtime_validation.py hashes exactly this list into benchmarks/protocol_v1/runtime_validation.json at admission time; any later edit invalidates admission.

pending_items: No native admission record exists yet: benchmarks/protocol_v1/runtime_validation.json is produced only after the three-seed training releases the GPU.
Agile CUDA parity has not been measured; the CPU conversion parity exists.
TopoTraj's 4.5 m mapping range and fixed 6.0 m/s^2 acceleration ceiling are documented differences whose fairness impact is not yet quantified.
MPPI reference 17 has no implementation; its 300 slots remain unfilled and are reported as such.
prohibitions: No official YOPO weights or the Simple profile may fill primary-matrix slots.
No other MPPI project may stand in for reference 17.
No tuning on the frozen benchmark maps; all thresholds are fixed before execution.
